name: National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9: Hoenn to Paldea)
author: HyruleChosenOne
description: Adds Gen 3-9 Pokémon (#252-#1025) with animated sprites, Dual Shinies, custom moves, and Ultimates.

patches.replace: async _pbLocalizeMods(){try{const lang=t()||`en`,urls=[...new Set(window.__pbI18nUrls||[])];if(!urls.length)return;const packs=await Promise.all(urls.map(u=>fetch(u).then(r=>r.ok?r.json():null).then(d=>d?Object.assign(d,{_u:u}):null).catch(()=>null)));for(const pk of packs){if(!pk)continue;window.__pbApplyModI18nData?.(pk);const L=pk.langs?.[lang]||pk.langs?.en;if(!L)continue;if(L.pokemon||L.flavor||L.roles){for(const p of this.all){const k=String(p.id);if(L.pokemon?.[k])p.name=L.pokemon[k];if(L.flavor?.[k])p.flavor=L.flavor[k];if(L.roles?.[k])p.role=L.roles[k]}}if(L.moves){for(const[mk,mv]of this.movesByKey){const tr=L.moves[mk];if(typeof tr===`string`)mv.name=tr;else if(tr&&typeof tr===`object`){if(tr.name)mv.name=tr.name;if(tr.flavor)mv.flavor=tr.flavor}}}if(L.items){for(const[ik,it]of Object.entries(this.items)){const tr=L.items[ik];if(tr?.name)it.name=tr.name;if(tr?.desc)it.desc=tr.desc}}if(L.ults&&typeof NC!==`undefined`){for(const[uid,tr]of Object.entries(L.ults)){const u=NC[Number(uid)];if(u&&tr){if(tr.name)u.names=[tr.name];if(tr.desc)u.descs=[tr.desc]}}}if(L.biomes&&Array.isArray(window.__pbBiomesRef)){for(const b of window.__pbBiomesRef){const tr=L.biomes[b.id];if(tr){if(tr.name)b.name=tr.name;if(tr.desc)b.desc=tr.desc;if(tr.sanctuary&&b.sanctuary)b.sanctuary.name=tr.sanctuary;if(tr.landmark&&b.landmark)b.landmark.name=tr.landmark}}}if(L.regions&&Array.isArray(window.__pbRegionsRef)){for(const rg of window.__pbRegionsRef){const tr=L.regions[rg.id];if(tr)rg.name=tr}}}}catch(e){console.warn(`[ModI18n]`,e)}}async localize(){
